svg.title: How Tollgate works, with its three feedback loops
svg.desc: An isometric scene. You ask in plain words. The AI writes a plan, and fresh AIs review it; when they find problems, it goes back to the plan. The tests are locked before any code. The AI builds in its own room. At the gate, the locked tests decide: on a fail, what failed goes back to the builder; when it is stuck, the advisor decides; on a pass, the barrier lifts and the change goes into main. The retro turns lessons into stricter rules for the next plan. A dot shows one change travelling: it fails once, then passes.
svg.text: three loops: check the plan, build until the tests pass, learn
